rationale: Caption, subtitle and narration parsing, validation, timing hard limits, UAF authorization, provider admission, Model Router selection and HRB resource admission remain deterministic authorities. Decision Fabric may only provide bounded advisory ranking among already-eligible editorial or workflow alternatives where human review or multiple policy-valid choices exist.

decision_points.final_policy_owner: FA3-CAPTION-SUBTITLE-001 with FA3-UNIFIED-ACTION-FABRIC-001 and human editorial approval

decision_points.purpose: rank already-eligible narration planning alternatives while voice provider/model selection remains outside Decision Fabric
